answer: Locks are written down in kernel, expire in lotus, and lagoon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 156 aliases therefore needs 68 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2258 identities would post 1949 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
